themes.description: Patients are being double-charged via the ClearPay auto-payment portal for copays, leading to billing disputes, refunds, and even collections.
themes.evidence: Multiple calls report duplicate charges of $45 or $30, with refunds, collections referrals, and patient frustration.
themes.recommended_action: Investigate ClearPay integration to prevent duplicate auto-charges and implement a monitoring system.

themes.description: Agents disclose protected health information or confidential business information without proper verification or authorization.
themes.evidence: Examples include disclosing another customer's info, husband's account, medication list, pricing, and appointment details.
themes.recommended_action: Reinforce HIPAA and confidentiality training, and enforce strict verification protocols before sharing any information.

themes.description: Agents make promises (refunds, credits, waivers) that exceed their authority, leading to policy violations and potential financial loss.
themes.evidence: Agents guaranteed refunds, zeroed balances, promised credits, and covered lost wages without approval.
themes.recommended_action: Implement a clear approval process for any financial commitments and train agents on their authority limits.

themes.description: Agents provide incorrect or misleading information about coverage, contract terms, or product capabilities.
themes.evidence: Misleading claims about cancel-anytime, guaranteed savings, full coverage, and BAA availability.
themes.recommended_action: Provide accurate product and policy information to agents and require verification before making claims.

themes.description: Patients receive contradictory pre-procedure instructions via text and packet, causing confusion and cancellations.
themes.evidence: Two calls report conflicting dietary instructions for procedures, leading to a cancelled colonoscopy and an escalation.
themes.recommended_action: Standardize communication channels and ensure consistency between text and printed materials.

themes.description: Agents promise callbacks or transfers that do not happen, leading to patient frustration and escalation.
themes.evidence: A promised transfer to billing was not completed, and a callback was never made, contributing to a collections referral.
themes.recommended_action: Implement a tracking system for promised actions and follow up to ensure completion.

themes.description: Agents fail to properly verify caller identity before disclosing information or making changes.
themes.evidence: Medication list disclosed without verification, and appointment details given with approximate DOB.
themes.recommended_action: Enforce strict identity verification procedures, including exact DOB and authorization checks.

themes.description: Agents experience system slowness, login issues, and other technical problems during calls, affecting service quality.
themes.evidence: Multiple calls mention re-logins, system slowness, and other technical glitches.
themes.recommended_action: Improve system reliability and provide agents with better tools to handle technical issues.
